Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=4]Requested by Harold45[/size]

[center][size=6][b]✦ Simple Bank & Charity ✦[/b][/size]

[size=5][color=#FFE680][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[size=4][size=5][b]💰 Banking & controls[/b][/size]

On PC, open with F9 or the shared inventory bank shortcut. On Android, use the Bank button inside the inventory. Standard amounts offers 100g, 1,000g, 10,000g and 100,000g steps; Large amounts offers 1,000,000g, 10,000,000g and 100,000,000g steps for banking and charity. Click + or the number to add a step, or - to subtract it. Switching groups keeps your pending amount. Max respects available funds and wallet capacity. Review projected balances, then confirm. Transfers do not increase lifetime earnings or money-earned achievements. Mouse, keyboard and controller menu navigation are supported.

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]⚙ UI size[/color][/b][/size]

Open the gear button in banking or charity to choose 75%–150% in 5% steps. The bank previews the size while you adjust it. Save keeps your preference after restarting the game; Cancel, Escape or controller B discards the draft. Default previews 100% until you save. Banking, charity, gifts and history share the saved preference and automatically fit smaller screens without changing it. The same UI-scale setting is available in optional Generic Mod Config Menu or as UiScalePercent in config.json.

[size=5][b]💜 Charity & rewards[/b][/size]

Choose wallet or bank funding; confirmation identifies the source and reward count. The default minimum is 1,000g, with one donation per farmer per game day. Each payment is capped at 2,147,483,647g, even if savings exceed it. Bank-funded donations leave your wallet untouched.

Standard reward counts increase with the amount: 1,000g → 1; 25,000g → 3; 100,000g → 10; 500,000g → 20; 2m → 30; 10m → 50; 50m → 60; wallet maximum → 80. Extra rare rolls: none through 500,000g; 2 at 500,001–2m; 5 above 2m–10m; 10 above 10m–50m; 15 above 50m. These are item rewards, not gold refunds.

Unclaimed rewards accumulate without rerolling. Claim transfers what fits and retains leftovers, including non-stackable furniture, weapons and wearables. Donation History keeps the latest 100 payments and their funding source. Saved rewards remain claimable when charity or a category is disabled.

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🎁 Allowed reward categories[/color][/b][/size]

Open [b]Generic Mod Config Menu → Simple Bank & Charity → Allowed reward categories[/b], or edit config.json. Toggle Artisan goods, Animal products, Artifacts, Cooking, Craftable items, Furniture, Ingredients, Minerals, Resources, Special items, Weapons and Wearable items. All twelve start enabled.

[b]Expanded reward selection[/b] starts enabled and combines a curated selection with your configured pools. The default selection contains 47 items, including craftables, chairs, swords, hats and boots. Special-item additions are utility warp totems; quest and progression tokens are excluded. Golden Walnuts, Stardrops and Qi Gems remain blocked. Turning expansion off keeps only your configured pools.

Category switches cover this reviewed selection. Custom entries outside it remain controlled by Advanced reward groups. Existing item weights, quantities and custom groups are preserved; a disabled advanced group can still exclude items from an enabled category. If the required reward pools are empty, payment is blocked. Saved gifts and donation history stay intact.

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]🔁 Repeatable charity[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Repeatable charity is off by default.[/b] Off uses Charity.DonationsPerDay: normally one donation per day; an existing advanced value of 0 still means unlimited. Turn it on to remove the daily limit and make additional manual donations. Every payment still needs an amount and confirmation; there are no automatic or scheduled donations. Turning it off restores your configured limit without clearing today's count.

Use GMCM Save to retain category and repeatable preferences after restarting. Advanced reward groups, daily limits, tiers, pool weights and quantities remain configurable in config.json; see QuickStart.txt.

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]📱 Android inventory button[/color][/b][/size]

Choose the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54817?tab=files#file-expander-header-189608]Android file[/url] on the Files tab. Open the inventory and tap Bank in the lower character panel. Put down or deselect held items first; Bank does not open while items are held, selected or dragged. Tap Back in Bank to return to the inventory. The saved ShowShortcut setting controls the inventory button.

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]📞 Mobile Phone access — optional PC mod[/color][/b][/size]

On PC, with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url] installed, open its Bank app to use the same bank menu. Enable phone access controls app launching; its icon may remain visible when disabled. Mobile Phone is optional: F9 and the inventory shortcut work without it. Phone access follows the same game-state and single-player restrictions.

[size=5][b]📖 Ledger & saved data[/b][/size]

On PC, optional Money Ledger 1.12+ records new deposits/withdrawals as transfers, excluded from income/spending. Wallet charity is spending; bank charity is recorded here by source, not a named external Ledger category. Earlier unlabelled entries are unchanged.

Accounts, gifts and history save per farmer in normal saves. Unsaved quitting rolls back wallet/account/rewards; unreadable/unsupported data is preserved and blocks affected actions. Withdraw needed gold/claim gifts before uninstalling; retained mod data can return on reinstall.

[size=5][b]📦 Requirements & scope[/b][/size]

Choose one download for your platform: PC requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4; the Android file targets Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]SMAPI for Android 4.3.2.5[/url]. Extract one SimpleBank folder into Mods and keep config.json when updating. Install either the PC file or the Android file, never both. Banking and charity transactions are single-player only and blocked in multiplayer. Banking text and the amount-group, phone, category, repeatable and reward-group settings include twelve languages; some existing charity text remains English. The Android category expansion has not yet been tested on a physical device. Mobile Phone and Generic Mod Config Menu are optional. Optional UI themes are separate.
